environment: Isolated Chrome for Testing, actual MV3, native IndexedDB and UI. Synthetic metadata only. No API permission or credentials installed.

checks.name: Capture reasons distinguish foreground, exclusion and pause; repeated state reads are sampled; paused browsing suppresses behavior logs
Actual prediction display and successful open are distinct, and reading diagnostics does not create visits or log events
Completion adoption is separate from save; edited text and discarded drafts are not counted as candidate saves
Grouping preview, actual apply and actual undo are logged; an empty undo is not counted as an action
Focus selection, pause and real continuation are logged after successful actions
Logs persist independently, exclude content and credentials, stay out of task backups, and keep unknown API usage unknown
Native log database enforces seven-day expiry, 5,000 rows, durable disable and safe clear/reset
Settings export downloads a real content-free JSON artifact
Diagnostics UI 320px remains readable and has no overflow or duplicate IDs
Diagnostics UI 360px remains readable and has no overflow or duplicate IDs
Diagnostics UI 1440px remains readable and has no overflow or duplicate IDs
Settings toggle stops new writes; explicit log clear preserves tasks and AI configuration
Clear history clears diagnostics; clear all restores the log default without resurrecting old events
An empty result is visible as an empty state, without a false candidate impression
